The US government backs OpenAI in the copyright fight

You can want AI to help with your work and want the work you create to be respected.

Updated September 4: This article now explains where Astra sits in OpenAI’s range and how it compares with Sol and Fable 5.1.OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3.
